name: Millet
siboNotes: Millet is well-tolerated in SIBO as it's naturally gluten-free and doesn't contain problematic fibers. Cook thoroughly for easier digestion.
preparationTips: Toast dry millet in a pan for 2-3 minutes for nuttier flavor
Use 1:2.5 ratio (millet to water) for fluffy texture
Rinse before cooking to remove any bitter coating
Can be cooked like rice or ground into flour for baking
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein (6g per cup cooked)
Good source of magnesium and phosphorus
